notes: Ti:sapphire is treated as a four-level system (no lasing-band absorption); the residual infrared absorption (figure of merit) is not included -- add it with absorptionProfile or a material attenuation

doping.source: doping density of the original code; give your crystal's doping

lifetime.source: Moulton, JOSA B 3, 125 (1986) (lifetime 3.2 us), as cited by the original code; not re-read

thermal.uncertainty: not stated in the original code

emission.description: asymmetric-Gaussian fit, pi polarisation: 3.0e-19 cm^2 at 795 nm, half widths 75 / 140 nm
emission.source: after Moulton, JOSA B 3, 125 (1986) (pi-polarised cross sections, lifetime 3.2 us); four-level; approximate analytic fit (~10-20 %) -- override with measured tables

absorption.description: Gaussian fit, pi polarisation: 6.4e-20 cm^2 at 490 nm, 115 nm FWHM (~4.4e-20 cm^2 at 532 nm)
absorption.source: after Moulton, JOSA B 3, 125 (1986) (pi-polarised); approximate analytic fit (~10-20 %) -- override with measured tables
